ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee (paid to driver); close the dispute with no refund.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat [F10][F11], driver statement [F14] and the complaint contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark, dangerous-driving allegation or safety indicator → safety_concern = none; no escalation on that basis.

Clause selection: the driver cancelled, and cancellation was for rider no-show (chat "No reply from you … cancelling" [F11]; driver statement "No rider, so I cancelled" [F14]) → NS-1 governs (NS-0).

NS-1 conditions, checked against system records (which override statements):
(i) Arrival: driver tapped "I'm Here" at 18:21:55 [F7] and the platform recorded arrival at 18:21:55 [F6]; GPS shows he was 40 m from the pickup point at that moment [F3][F7], well inside the 200 m radius, and his closest approach was 38 m [F1]. Met.
(ii) Wait: the 5-minute free wait runs from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival. Counting from arrival at 18:21:55, the 5 minutes expired at 18:26:55; the driver cancelled at 18:27:55, i.e. 6 min 0 s after arrival [F4][F6]. Met (also 6 min 15 s cumulative time within 200 m [F2]).
(iii) Contact: before cancelling the driver sent 2 in-app messages (first 18:22:25) and made 1 in-app call (first 18:23:25, not answered) [F5][F12][F13] — at least 1 message and 1 call. Met.
(iv) Continuous presence: GPS shows the driver stationary at (1.3325, 103.7415), 40 m from pickup, from 18:21:55 to 18:27:55 [F3], and within 200 m for the whole 6 min 0 s after the tap [F7]. No GPS gap. Met.

All four NS-1 hold, so the $5.00 fee stands [F4][F8]. The rider's "I came out a minute after the driver cancelled" does not displace the record: the driver completed the full free-wait period plus the contact attempts before cancelling. No traffic or weather factor is relevant to a no-show (no incidents, no speed bands [F15][F16]; fair weather [F17]). The driver picked no cancellation reason in the app [F4], but his own words [F11][F14] identify no-show, which is the chargeable case; this is not NS-3 (no fee) and not NS-2 (voided fee), and no NS-1 sub-condition failed. Rider profile (0 no-shows, 0 disputes in 90 d) does not decide the case and there are no repeat no-shows to flag under NS-9. No fraud indicator on either side, so no flag_account. Surge is 1.0× [F9], so SURGE clauses are irrelevant. Amount under dispute is $5.00, TH-1 under $10 / no-show under TH-2 → system ruling final. Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel, zero contact, $5.00) is the closest no-show precedent; here the driver additionally made contact and waited the full period, which only strengthens the fee. Evidence_status: sufficient — GPS, timestamps, contact log and cancellation time are all present.

Arrival 18:21:55, cancellation 18:27:55 = 6 min 0 s wait; 6 min 15 s cumulative within 200 m.

element_findings.element: Pre-cancellation contact: ≥1 in-app message and ≥1 in-app call (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: 2 timestamped messages (first 18:22:25) and 1 call (18:23:25, unanswered) both before 18:27:55 cancellation.
Stationary 18:21:55–18:27:55 at 40 m from pickup, within 200 m the whole time; no GPS gap.
Driver's own words state no rider response/no-show, so NS-1 applies rather than NS-3.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider says she came out one minute after cancellation, but the system timeline [F4][F6] shows the driver waited the full 5-minute free period (6 min 0 s after arrival) and completed the required message and call before cancelling; the record controls.
